subject: Co-sell listing: proposed tiered marketplace credit structure for Acme Analytics
messages:
From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: marketplace listing + credit structure for Acme pilot

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the call earlier — Acme is excited about listing on AWS Marketplace with Redwood as the provided inference runtime. Our procurement lead asked for a proposed credit/discount structure for the initial pilot (6-12 months) that we can present internally alongside estimated cost offsets.

High level:
- Pilot: 6 months with option to extend to 12 months
- Expected monthly consumption: ~120k tokens/day (bursty) initially
- Goal: test Redwood in production for a pilot product line, then expand to enterprise licensing if results look good

Can you send a simple tiered credit proposal (e.g., commit vs. consumption tiers) and any marketplace listing timelines? Attaching the RFP and a short customer note.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Liu
Product Partnerships, Acme Analytics
attachments: acme_rfp.pdf, acme-customer-case-summary.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: marketplace listing + credit structure for Acme pilot

Vanessa / Tessa — forwarding Acme's ask. They're a strategic analytics ISV (fast ARR growth, good co-sell motion with AWS). They want a 6-12 month pilot credit structure tied to marketplace listing. Key asks below.

Summary / ask:
- Need approval for a tiered credit model for marketplace listing (suggested: 10% standard credit + additional 5% for commit-based tier or alternative commit credits) for a 6–12 month pilot.
- They're sensitive to price; pilot could convert to a sizable dedicated contract in year 2 (est. $200k ACV if expanded).
- Timeline: want listing and co-sell enablement within 6–8 weeks.

Attachments: co-sell-pricing-model.xlsx (proposed structure spreadsheet)

Please advise on credit % we can offer and whether we require a monetary commit vs. consumption-only pilot.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: marketplace listing + credit structure for Acme pilot

Ben — thanks for the context and the model. A few things I need before any approval:

1) Clear ARR / expansion signal: what is the expected first-year ARR if the pilot converts? You noted ~$200k — please put that in writing with the assumptions.
2) Customer logo & go-to-market: what co-sell motion does AWS expect to run? Are they committing to internal co-sell calls and joint opportunities?
3) Credit guardrails: propose a max total credit cap for the pilot (we typically cap credits for marketplace pilots to limit exposure).
4) Approvals: we may be able to approve a preliminary credit of up to 12% total for a committed pilot with a capped exposure and a joint MOU. Anything above that needs VP sign-off.

If you can provide the ARR assumptions and a short one-page mutual action plan (who does what and timelines), I can route for provisional approval. CCing Tessa for billing/finance input on cap and recognition.

- Vanessa
Director, Partnerships & Alliances
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@acmeanalytics.com>, AWS Partner Sales <aws.partner@amazon-partner.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Aug 2027 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: marketplace listing + credit structure for Acme pilot

Vanessa / Tessa — adding the requested details below and attaching the simple MAP and model.

ARR assumptions:
- Pilot -> conversion probability: 40% over 12 months
- If expanded to enterprise, estimated ARR (year 1 post-expansion): $200k (based on existing similar customers and Acme’s pipeline)
- Pilot expected billings to Redwood (if fully paid): ~$40k total over 6 months (consumption-based).

Joint GTM: AWS has committed to a partner campaign and 2 joint sales motions (introductory webinars + 3 enterprise intro meetings). Sarah confirms willingness to be referenceable.

Proposed credit structure (from spreadsheet):
- Tier A (no commit): 8% marketplace credit on consumption for first 6 months (cap $10k)
- Tier B (3-month minimum commit): 12% credit + $5k sign-on credit (cap $25k)
- Tier C (6-month monetary commit): 18% credit + $10k sign-on credit (cap $50k)

We recommend approving Tier B as a balanced approach (encourages commitment but limits exposure).

Attachments: co-sell-pricing-model.xlsx, RDW-acme-MAP.pdf

Sarah — can you confirm the joint GTM commitments in writing so Vanessa can route?

Thanks,
Ben
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: marketplace listing + credit structure for Acme pilot

Team — reviewed the numbers and the MAP. Finance will provisionally approve Tier B (12% credit + $5k sign-on credit) for a 6-month pilot, with the following guardrails:

- Credit cap: $25,000 total exposure
- Formal MOU signed within 14 days specifying joint GTM activities and measurement criteria (usage thresholds, SLA expectations)
- Credit will be issued as a marketplace promotional credit applied to invoices; any unused credits expire at pilot end
- Any increase above Tier B or extension >12 months requires VP Partnerships sign-off and legal review for marketplace listing terms

Ben — I'll generate the internal approval note and a DocuSign template for the MOU. Sarah — once you sign the MOU we can start listing tasks with AWS and provision co-sell enablement.

- Tessa
Finance Manager, Revenue Operations
attachments: approval-memo.pdf
